notes: P07 furniture placements. pos = [x, height above the room's level floor, z] in house coords (X east, Z south). rotY deg: 0 = front faces +Z (south), 90 = east, 180 = north, -90 = west. snap pushes the piece against the wall on that side; drop lands it on the surface below. proc = procedural generator (src/game/furnish/proc).
